questions.stem: What are the elective indications for splenectomy?
questions.answer: Haematological disease and thrombocytopenia, or cancer staging

questions.stem: What are the emergency indications for splenectomy?
questions.answer: Trauma, ruptured splenic aneurysm, or uncontrollable bleeding

questions.stem: Why might sickle cell disease patients need transfusion before splenectomy?
In ITP, when are platelets usually given during splenectomy?
Why check chemotherapy history before splenectomy for Hodgkin's staging?
questions.answer: Some drugs affect kidney, lung and heart function
